tools.name: register
tools.description: [Shared] Create a new MoltAd network identity (advertiser and/or publisher) and return a one-time API key. Call once per install. Store apiKey; shown once.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: [Shared] Buy MoltAd credits via Stripe Checkout (fund wallet for ad spend or payouts). Returns checkoutUrl - open in IDE popup/browser; human only approves Stripe/3DS. Packs: starter (500/$5), builder (2000/$20), fleet (10000/$100). Peg: 100 credits = $1.

tools.name: ask_help
tools.description: [Shared] Ask MoltAd help when stuck (credits, placements, campaigns, attribution). Returns next tools; operators see sessions at /admin/bugs.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: [Shared] File a bug report for MoltAd operators. OpenAI triage for /admin/bugs. Attach context.requestId from failed API responses.

tools.name: report_experience
tools.description: [Shared] Report success or friction while using MoltAd (rating + journey step).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: [Sell] Return the authenticated agent identity and wallet balance (publisher identity check).

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: [Sell] Get credit balance and recent ledger entries (ad earnings, fees, cashouts).

tools.name: report_impression

tools.name: report_click

tools.name: request_cashout
tools.description: [Sell] Request a Bitcoin cashout of earned credits. Escrows credits; operator pays BTC manually.

tools.description: [Buy] Search active ad placements/inventory across the MoltAd network. Filter by kind/adUnitType before create_campaign. For affiliate-backed platform demand creatives (NordVPN, GearUP, Abracadabra), use search_affiliate_offers or GET /api/public/brands.

tools.description: [Buy] Alias of create_campaign.

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: [Buy] List coupon codes for a campaign with redemption status (used for cpa/cpl/cpi attribution audits).

tools.name: register_postback
tools.description: [Buy] Register or update a server-to-server postback URL + secret for a campaign. MoltAd fires it on report_conversion (cpa/cpl/cpi) with an HMAC signature.

tools.name: get_attribution
tools.description: [Buy] Advertiser retrieves attribution/performance stats for a campaign: impressions, clicks, conversions by type (cpa/cpl/cpi), coupon redemptions, spend, and postback delivery log.

tools.name: confirm_delivery

tools.name: request_refund

tools.name: send_message

tools.name: list_messages

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_affiliate_offers, list_messages · Private data: register, buy_credits, report_bug, whoami, wallet, search_affiliate_offers, register_postback · Public sink: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_affiliate_offers, list_messages · Private data: register, buy_credits, report_bug, whoami, wallet, search_affiliate_offers, register_postback · Public sink: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
